title: viRusneRd5/cmvresistancefinder pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and can only contain letters, numbers, '.', '_' and '-' (no spaces, colons, slashes, etc.) - it is used directly as an output file name throughout the pipeline, and characters such as ':' can silently break some tools (e.g. samtools) even though nothing else flags them as invalid.

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'. Paths may be absolute or relative to the samplesheet.

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'. Paths may be absolute or relative to the samplesheet.
